questions.question: On a racing track, A and B are standing at a distance of 200 m. A walked towards B at a speed of 8 km/h, whereas B walked in the same direction at a speed of 5 km/h. What was the distance between them 1 minute before they met?
questions.solution:
Formula:

D = S × T, where

D = Distance

S = Speed

T = Time

Concept:

When two objects move in the same direction, their relative speed will be the difference of their speeds.

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/126f7c5ebf98b48e39023ac09583e12fc06a093a88a8ba8cabd22d808b931a4f.png] 

Let the time at which they meet be "t" sec.

Distance travelled by A = 8 × 5over18 × t = 40tover18

Distance travelled by B = 5 × 5over18 × t = 25tover18

According to the question,

40tover18 - 25tover18 = 200 m

⇒ 15t = 200 × 18

∴ t = 240 sec or 4min

⇒ (t - 1) sec = (4 - 1) = 3 min 

Relative speed = 8 - 5 = 3 km/hr

Relative speed in m/s = 3 × 5over18 = 5over6 m/s

Total time = 3 min = 3 × 60 = 180 sec

Distance covered = 5over6 × 180 = 150 m

Distance left = 200 - 150 = 50 m

∴ The distance between A and B after (t - 1) seconds is 50 m.

questions.question:
If the volume of a cone is 770 cm³ and its height is 15 cm, then the radius of its base is:

(Take π = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
Given:

Volume of cone = 770 cm3 

Height of cone = 15 cm

Formula:

Volume of cone = 1over 3 × π × r2 × h 

Where, r = radius of the cone, and h = height of the cone

Calculation:

According to the question-

⇒ 1/3 × 22/7 × r × r × 15 = 770

⇒ 2/7 × r × r × 5 = 70

⇒ r × r = (70 × 7)/(2 × 5)

⇒ r × r = 7 × 7

⇒ r = 7 cm

∴ The radius of the base of the cone is 7 cm.

questions.question: In a mixture, the ratio of milk and water is 5 ∶ 3. If 4 litres of water is added to the mixture, the ratio becomes 3 ∶ 2. Find the quantity of milk in the mixture.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Initially, Milk : Water = 5 : 3

After adding 4 ltrs, Milk : Water = 3 : 2

So, Quantity of Milk is unchanged.

Now, We can write 

Old Milk : Water = 5 : 3 = 15 : 9

New Milk : Water = 3 : 2 = 15 : 10

So, (10 - 9) = 1 unit of water is added.

⇒ 1 unit = 4 ltrs 

⇒ 15 unit = 4 × 15 = 60 ltrs

∴ The quantity of milk in the mixture was 60 litres.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initially, Milk : Water = 5 : 3

After adding 4 ltrs, Milk : Water = 3 : 2

Calculation:

Let the total quantity of milk and water in the solution be 5a, and 3a.

According to the question-

⇒ 5aover 3a+4 = 3over 2

⇒ 10a = 9a + 12

⇒ a = 12 

∴ Quantity of milk in the mixture = 5 × 12 = 60 litres

∴ The quantity of milk in the mixture was 60 litres.

questions.question: A train leaves a station at 4:50 p.m. and reaches the next station 45 km away at 5:44 p.m. If the train runs at a uniform speed, what is the speed (in km/h) of the train?
questions.solution:
Formula:

Speed = Total distance covered ÷ Total time 

Calculation:

Total time taken = 5:44 pm - 4:50 pm = 54 min = 54/60 hrs

Speed = 45/(54/60) = 45 × 60/54 = 50 km/h

∴ The speed of the train is 50 km/h.

questions.question: 75 workers could complete only one-third of a work in 20 days. It is desired that the work be finished in the next 30 days. How many more workers should be taken to complete the work in the desired time?
questions.solution:
Formula:

M₁ × D₁over W₁ = M₂ × D₂ over W₂

Where,

M1 and M2 = Number of men working on D1 and D2

D1 and D2 = Days for which M1 and M2 worked respectively

W₁ and W₂ = Portion of work finished

Calculations:

Remaining work = 1 - 1/3 = 2/3

Let, the number of additional men required to be y

According to the question,

⇒ (75 × 20)/(1/3) = [(75 + y) × 30]/(2/3)

⇒ 1500 × 3 = [2250 + 30y] × 3/2

⇒ 3000 = 2250 + 30y

⇒ 30y = 750 

⇒ y = 25

∴ The additional men needed is 25.

questions.question: The average weight of 14 boys in a class is 40.25 kg and that of the remaining 10 boys is 35.15 kg. Find the average weight of all the boys in the class.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Average weight of 14 boys = 40.25 kg

Average age of 10 boys = 35.15 kg

Total no. of boys = 24

So, Average weight of 24 boys

⇒ [(14 × 40.25) + (10 × 35.15)]/24

⇒ [563.5 + 351.5]/24 = 38.125 kg

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average weight of 14 boys = 40.25 kg

Average age of 10 boys = 35.15 kg

Total no. of boys = 24

Formula:

Average = Sum of total observations/No. of observations

Calculation:

Sum of the weight of 14 boys = 14 × 40.25 = 563.5 kg

Sum of the weight of 10 boys = 10 × 35.15 kg = 351.5 kg

Sum of total weight = 563.5 + 351.5 = 915 kg

⇒ Average = 915/(14 + 10) = 38.125 kg

∴The average weight of all boys was 38.125 kg.

∴ The cost price is Rs 500.

questions.question: Arya borrowed some money at the rate of 5% per annum for the first 3 years, at the rate of 8% per annum for the next 4 years, and at the rate of 16% per annum for the period beyond seven years. If he pays a total interest of Rs. 15,730 at the end of 13 years, then how much money did he borrow?
questions.solution:
Formula:

SI = (P x R x T) / 100

Effective interest rate = T × R

Where, P = Principal amount, R = Rate, T = Time

Calculation :

Let the principal be 100.

According to the question-

⇒ 5% p.a. for 3 years

∴ Effective rate for 3 year period = 5 × 3 = 15%

⇒ 8% p.a. for 4 years

∴ Effective rate for 4 year period = 8 × 4 = 32%

Remaining time = 13 - (3 + 4) = 6 years

⇒ 16% p.a. for 6 years

∴ Effective rate for the remaining 6 year period = 6 × 16 = 96%

Collective effective tax rate for 13 year period = 15% + 32% + 96% = 143%

∴ SI = (100 x 143 x 1) / 100 = 143

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58524b432668013b1719f23d0b23cd2cfd4748965b5ff4f47844aedb734a1a45.png] 

⇒ x = 15,730 × 100over143 = Rs 11,000

∴ The money borrowed is Rs 11,000.

questions.question: The average run rate of a cricketer in 48 innings is 33. His highest score exceeds his lowest score by 144 runs. If these two innings are excluded, the average run rate of the remaining 46 innings is 30 . What is the highest score of the player?
questions.solution:
Formula:

Average = Sum of total observations/Total no. of observation

Calculation:

Total runs scored in 48 innings = 48 × 33 = 1584

Total runs scored in the remaining 46 innings = 46 × 30 = 1,380

∴ Runs scored in the remaining 2 innings

⇒ 1,584 - 1,380 = 204

Let the highest runs scored be "h".

Let the lowest runs scored be "s".

According to the question-

⇒ h - s = 144 (Eq 1)

⇒ h + s = 204 (Eq 2)

Adding (Eq 1) and (Eq 2), we get-

⇒ 2h = 348 

∴ h = 174

∴ The highest score is 174.

questions.question: A and B together can do a certain work in 36 days, whereas B and C together can do it 40 days. A, B and C together can do it in 30 days. B alone can do (7)/(8) part of the original work in:
questions.solution:
Formula:

Efficiency = Total work / Time taken to complete work individually

**Concept Used:**

Assume total work days as the LCM value of the individual time required for the persons involved. 

Calculation:

Total work = LCM of 36, 40, 30 = 360 unit

Efficiency of A and B

⇒ 360over 36 = 10 units of work/day

Efficiency of B and C

⇒ 360over 40 = 9 unit of work/day

Efficiency of A, B and C

⇒ 360over 30 = 12 units of work/day

Efficiency of C = 12 - 10 = 2 units of work/day

Efficiency of B = 9 - 2 = 7 units of work/day

So, Time taken by B to complete the work = 360over 7 day

∴ Time taken to complete (7)/(8) part of the original work 

⇒ (7)/(8) × 360over 7 = 45 days.

∴ B would complete (7)/(8)th of the work in 45 days.

questions.question: A salesman sells an item at a profit of 21%. If he had bought it at 12% less and sold it for Rs. 66 less, he would have gained 30%. Find the cost price of the item.
questions.solution:

SP = CP × (1 + Gover100) 

Where, G = Gain%

Calculation:

Let, the original CP be 100 unit

original SP after 21% profit =100 × (100 +21)/100 = 121 unit

New CP = 100 × (100 -12)/100 = 88 unit

New SP after 30% gain = 88 × 130/100 = 114.4 unit

So, Difference in SP = (121 - 114.4) = 6.6 unit
